comment_box: See attached file(s): As you can see below, this comment section is being flooded with bots posing as concerned citizens advocating against life saving care for women enlisted/veterans. I’m here to tell you I wouldn’t be alive to care for my family today if not for these exact services. My family would crumble without me, leading to the creation of generational poverty that you know full well costs the American tax payer significantly more than if proper services were provided. This policy will kill millions of women and leave fathers destitute and children fending for themselves while dad is at work, putting them at risk of predation, forever altering their upward mobility due to the damage left in its wake. BY NATURE ALONE any pregnant woman at any time can experience miscarriage or improper implantation or ectopic pregnancy, none of which are viable and ALL OF WHICH can and will not only cause irreparable damage leading to  debilitating results that impede one’s ability to function, could lead to disability and can/will absolutely kill the mother if left untreated. What you’re seeking to do is the equivalent of Russia sending millions of its citizens and duped foreigners to slaughter using them as cannon fodder. What’s your plan when you’ve lost your male constituents so many women? What do you think you will have on your hands if your plan comes to fruition? You’ve successfully weaponized them in your favor up to this point but your little minions will turn on you over this and lord we know how much planning has gone into “what to do if my minions turn on me” I personally  know the guy yall hire to give you lectures on survival.
